## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior, safety impact, and current-versus-planned status.

## Validation

- [ ] Frozen design hash verification passes.
- [ ] Relevant .NET simulator/unit tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant Python Ruff/pytest checks pass.
- [ ] No raw data, generated products, runtime state, private credentials, or local configuration is included.
- [ ] Physical-device ownership remains one owner per device.
- [ ] Hardware actions are bounded, cancellable, logged, and covered by an explicit commissioning step.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated with behavior changes.
- [ ] Any architectural change includes explicit owner approval and a superseding ADR.
